adaptation: Relative imports; only weight_init retained from train_helpers; constants inlined. No upstream trainer or external repository needed. AutoEncoder conditional-count report metrics return zero for batches without partitioned scenes; the loss objective is unchanged. LDM adds an opt-in lane-conditioned training objective: clean lane latents for full and partitioned graphs, agent-only supervision retaining the released before-partition clean-agent/zero-target convention, with unchanged parameter schema and default joint objective. DDPM fixed-context restoration is factored into a helper and enforced before each denoising call as well as after clipping; the original sampler already restored conditions between steps, so seeded sampling math and checkpoint parameters are unchanged.
